title: One-Skillet Lasagna
description: A slightly soupy, spoon-ready skillet lasagna with soy crumbles, Impastable pasta, and a ricotta and mozzarella layer.

steps.title: Brown crumbles
steps.text: Heat a 12 inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add {crumbles} and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season the crumbles with {garlicpowder}, {onionpowder}, {italian}, {paprika}, {salt}, {pepper} and optional {heat}.

steps.title: Add pasta and liquids
steps.text: Add {pasta}, {sauce}, {water} and {paste}. Stir well so everything is coated.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Cover and simmer gently for 12 to 14 minutes, stirring every 3 to 4 minutes so the pasta does not stick.

steps.title: Check texture
steps.text: You want fully cooked pasta and a loose, spoonable sauce that is not watery. If it gets too thick, add 2 to 4 tbsp water. If it is too loose, simmer uncovered for 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Lasagna layer
steps.text: Turn the heat to low. Dollop {ricotta} across the top.
Cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until melted and gooey.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes. This is where it becomes skillet lasagna instead of pasta in sauce. It thickens slightly but stays spoon-friendly.

notes: Texture: slightly soupy, cozy, spoon-ready. About 25 minutes start to finish.
